snippet.title: Trailer Golf5 eClub Forest
snippet.description:
Golf5eClub is a fully immersive authentic golf experience. Learn and improve your golf by taking the full swing. Analyze ball striking with real-time data. Lower your handicap and compete with IEGF rules.  
Fresh update:       
- New course with 9 holes (Forest) and playable rough       
- New ultra-realistic game physics High Precision Control 
- All your swing data in real time with Xtra Tracking Info 
- Extra Visual info for “Hazard” and “Out of bounds” areas
 - New app for IOS and Android - Set of clubs Fato Dogo 
- Now in 4 languages: English, Spanish, Japanese and Korean 

It includes: 
• 18 hole courses (Dunes) + 9 holes (Forest) where you can play, train and compete 
• Practice range to perfect your swing 
• Putting green, with multiple game options 
• With little time, the WIPP version 
• Mini-golf for the whole family  

Play online, compete and chat with friends from all over the world in multiplayer mode.
